title: API Token Controls
scope: Admin controls, logging and revocation for API credentials on SaaS platforms. Sourced from vendor documentation; not an audit of any tenant.

definitions.conditional: Documented, with plan, policy or endpoint conditions.
definitions.excluded: The named control explicitly does not cover this credential.
definitions.not_supported: Vendor documentation states this credential lacks the control.
definitions.unknown: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_verified: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_applicable: Does not apply to this credential.
definitions.limited: Documented for a narrower case only.

providers.name: CircleCI
providers.scope_notes: Covers CircleCI Cloud. CircleCI cloud (Free, Performance, Scale); SAML SSO and audit log streaming need Scale, context security-group restrictions only on github-type orgs; CircleCI Server is out of scope.

controls.name: Personal API token expiry
controls.what: Every web-created token has an expiry of at most one year; DCR tokens last 90 days.

controls.name: SSO authentication for personal API tokens
controls.what: Tokens must be SSO-authorized per org to reach SSO-protected org resources.
controls.setting: User Settings > Personal API Tokens > SSO column

controls.name: Delete personal API token
controls.what: User deletes a token from the Remove column.

controls_unknown: Any org-admin setting to block, list or revoke members' personal API tokens.
Any org setting to disable OAuth Dynamic Client Registration tokens.
Any inbound IP allowlist for the CircleCI API or web app.
Whether personal API token create/delete or API reads appear in audit logs (not in the published event list).
Whether an SSO-authorized token stops working when the IdP session ends or the user is removed from the IdP.

auth_paths.name: Personal API tokens (incl. tokens from OAuth 2.0 Dynamic Client Registration)

authentication.summary: User-created token sent in the Circle-Token header or as Bearer to API v1/v2/v3. Web-created tokens have the user's full read/write access; tokens issued through the OAuth DCR flow are scoped Read/Write/Admin.

federation.details: In SSO-enabled orgs (Scale) a token must be SSO-authorized per org, and that option needs an active SSO session. Docs do not say whether the token stops when the SSO session ends.

ip_restriction.boundary: Docs describe only outbound job IP ranges; no inbound API allowlist documented.

lifetime.summary: User-set expiry up to 1 year; DCR tokens 90 days

renewal.summary: Delete and create a new token; email reminders before expiry.

administration.summary: Users create and delete their own tokens. Any tool can register an OAuth client without authentication and obtain a token once the user approves.
administration.conditions: No documented admin view, revoke or block for members' personal tokens.

sso.details: In an SSO-enabled org, a personal API token must be SSO-authenticated before it can reach the org's resources; SSO needs the Scale plan.

inventory.details: Each user sees and revokes only their own tokens on User Settings > Personal API Tokens; no admin-wide listing is documented.

sso.ui: Org > Single sign-on (SSO) > Enforce SSO for all users; each user: User Settings > Personal API Tokens > pick the org in the SSO column

usage.ui: Org > Security > Audit Logs > Request audit logs > Download logs (CSV); filter on actor. Scale: Stream audit logs to S3

log_sources.name: CircleCI audit logs
log_sources.notes: Org admin requests CSV for any 30-day window in last 12 months (Free 1/day, paid 3/day); Scale can stream to S3.

credential_id_fields.notes: User id/type/name; no token ID documented.

anomaly_cues: Pipelines triggered via API by a user outside normal hours
context.secrets.accessed from unexpected projects or branches
New env vars or project.settings.update by a token owner

containment.steps: User deletes and recreates the token; remove the user from the org/IdP; block new work and rotate secrets the user could reach.

unknown: Whether any API read is logged
